  "status": "partial",
  "rpwd_relevant_sections": [
    "RPwD Act 2016 Section 16: Duty of educational institutions to provide inclusive education, reasonable accommodation, and necessary support services."
  ],
  "ncte_relevant_sections": [
    "NCTE/NCERT Guidelines p. 30: Transacting curriculum through total communication, UDL-based approaches, and providing adequate facility of resource persons including occupational therapists and physiotherapists.",
    "NCTE/NCERT Guidelines p. 30: Ensuring implementation of equitable and inclusive education including aids, appliances, assistive devices, and technological support.",
    "NCTE/NCERT Guidelines p. 32: Provision of required support, monitoring its frequency and extent, and ensuring accessible infrastructure and transport facilities."
  ],
  "identified_gaps": [
    "Gap 1: The IEP lacks provision for specialized therapeutic support services (such as physiotherapy or occupational therapy) mandated for managing spastic diplegia.",
    "Gap 2: The IEP does not explicitly address accessible school transport or campus infrastructure modifications beyond classroom seating."
  ],
  "mandatory_accommodations": [
    "Provision of speech-to-text software, ergonomic keyboard and mouse setup, and adjustable-height desk with RPwD Act 2016 Section 16",
    "Access to allied health professionals such as physiotherapists and occupational therapists with NCTE/NCERT Guidelines p. 30",
    "Classroom and school infrastructure accessibility modifications with NCTE/NCERT Guidelines p. 30 and RPwD Act 2016 Section 16"
  ],
  "compliance_notes": "While the IEP adequately captures academic goals, assistive technology, and basic physical accommodations for Pooja Sharma's cerebral palsy, it lacks explicit integration of therapeutic support services (physiotherapy/occupational therapy) and broader infrastructural/transport accessibility as mandated by the RPwD Act and NCTE guidelines. Therefore, status is marked as partial."
}
